newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina auctions $750 mln Bontes at 8.78 pct.
newsitem.headline: Argentina auctions $750 mln Bontes at 8.78 pct.

text.p: Argentina sold $750 million in five year Bonte Treasury bonds at a cut-off yield of 8.78 percent, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
The issue price was 998,810. There were bids totaling $4.16 billion giving a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.54 times. The coupon on the bond is 8.75 percent.
The cut-off yield came in at the lower end of predictions. Market players surveyed by Reuters predicted the yield would come in between 8.75 percent and 9.0 percent.
This is the first tranche of the bond that matures on May 9, 2002. It will be raised to a total $2.0 billion in subsequent tranches to make the instrument more liquid.
This is Argentina's longest maturity Bonte in the local market.
